title: Emergency order.
bodyText: During a collaborative law process, a tribunal may issue emergency orders to protect the health, safety, welfare, or interest of a party or family or household member as defined in section 586-1.
bodyHtml: [§658G-7]  Emergency order.  During a collaborative law process, a tribunal may issue emergency orders to protect the health, safety, welfare, or interest of a party or family or household member as defined in section 586-1. [L 2012, c 207, pt of §1]
